jobs.prompt: Edit IMAGE 1, latest Odin sprite, into a restrained look-left gaze keyframe. IMAGE 2 is actual Odin for likeness, coat and asymmetric eyes. Keep the exact body, paws, tail, compressed flat floor contact, lighting, fur length/material, head size and canvas placement. Only turn the head a LITTLE toward image-left, about 15 degrees, with gaze toward that side; shoulders and torso stay absolutely still. Ear pinnae compact with just short sparse individual wispy extensions, not solid spiked triangles. Whole cat, all ears/whiskers/paws/tail within original transparent margins. Existing body, ruff and tail stay on original horizontal support; only existing paws overhang. No cropping, cut underside, floor/shadow, breathing, new props or text. Transparent background.
